title: On HP Poly EagleEye Cube USB 1.3.1-001267 devices, the administrator authentication flow is broken: session management…
description: HP Poly EagleEye Cube USB devices version 1.3.1-001267 have a vulnerability in the administrator authentication flow where session management and access controls are not enforced on the device. This flaw allows unauthenticated users to bypass login and perform administrative actions, including exporting configuration files containing internal administrator credentials and other network system credentials.
